findings: With weight segments, peak RSS falls with every dropped layer: 7,255 MiB dense, 6,780 (2 layers), 6,326 (4), 5,381 (8).
Before weight segments the 2-layer drop still peaked at 7,271 MiB: Metal kept the whole mapped file resident.

limitations: Decode speed varied from 13.3 to 17.0 tokens/s across identical dense runs on a warm machine; only memory is stable enough to compare run by run.
The 4- and 8-layer drops are experimental (+39% and +137% perplexity in the qualification evidence).
